entities.summary: Shutrukid, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Elamite Civilization (1500 BCE–539 BCE). Preceded by Middle and Neo-Elamite Kingdoms and Proto-Elamite and Old Elamite Periods. Their legacy influenced Ashurbanipal of Assyria destroys Susa and devastates Elam.
